listings.name: Take part in Carmel community volunteering
listings.description: The Carmel Residents Association lists beach cleanups and help with community programs and events.
listings.participation_note: Confirm the next activity, sign-up requirements and any membership conditions with the association.

listings.name: Follow Carmel board and commission opportunities
listings.description: Learn about city advisory bodies and sign up for recruitment notices. Responsibilities include planning, the urban forest and beach, and community activities.
listings.participation_note: Read current recruitment notices before applying. Archived deadlines are not open vacancies; residency and professional requirements vary.
